mcq.s:
With reference to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD), consider the following statements:
1. It aims to promote effective action through innovative national programmes and supportive international partnerships.
2. It has a special focus on South Asia and North Africa, and its Secretariat allocates the major portion of financial resources to these regions.
3. It is committed to a bottom-up approach, encouraging the participation of local people in combating desertification.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.x: The UNCCD (1994) promotes action through national programmes and partnerships and follows a bottom-up approach with local participation; it has no special South Asia/North Africa focus.

A. Biomagnification
B. Electrostatic precipitation
C. Landfills
D. Stratosphere
1. Synthesis of ozone
2. Solid waste
3. Concentration build-up at successive trophic levels

mcq.x: Biomagnification is build-up at successive trophic levels; electrostatic precipitators remove particulate matter; landfills hold solid waste; ozone forms in the stratosphere.

mcq.s: Which one of the following is NOT a biotic resource?
mcq.x: Biotic resources come from living or once-living matter, so fish, coal and petroleum count; freshwater is abiotic.
